# Papers to download

Save each PDF into `references/pdfs/` under the exact name in the first column (e.g. `Burton2008.pdf`), then tell
Claude. Running `python3 scripts/03_make_reports.py` (from `references/`) removes the row and updates the audit
table. The publisher's PDF is preferred over a PubMed Central page, because the audit then quotes page numbers.

Already on the server: the full texts listed in `citation_audit.md` (`pdfs/`), and abstracts of the other tier-A/B works (`abstracts/`).
